purpose: Reproducible evidence for the Python compiler empty control fix.

commands.command: uv run nl2repo harbor compile catalog/sources/email-validator --output .nl2repo/email-validator-empty-fix-compile --toolchain toolchain.lock.toml --artifact-root .nl2repo/artifacts --allow-private
uv run nl2repo harbor prepare-control .nl2repo/email-validator-empty-fix-compile/email-validator empty --output .nl2repo/email-validator-empty-fix-controls --toolchain toolchain.lock.toml

uv run --frozen --project harbor-runner harbor run -p .nl2repo/email-validator-empty-fix-controls/email-validator-empty -a oracle --job-name email-validator-empty-fixed-20260904 --jobs-dir .nl2repo/email-validator-empty-fix-runs/empty --n-concurrent 1 --max-retries 0 --yes
